# GET /api/users/:id

## Overview
This endpoint reads the profile data for one user. You supply the user ID. The system returns the user profile as a JSON object.

## Endpoint
`GET /api/users/:id`

## Method
`GET`

## Parameters

### Path Parameters

| Name | Type   | Required | Description                          |
|------|--------|----------|--------------------------------------|
| `id` | string | Yes      | The unique identifier of the user.   |

### Query Parameters
This endpoint does not use query parameters.

### Request Body
This endpoint does not use a request body.

## Example Request

```
GET /api/users/usr_8f3a21b9 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Accept: application/json
```

## Response Format

### Success — 200 OK

The system returns a user profile object.

```json
{
  "id": "usr_8f3a21b9",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "role": "developer",
  "created_at": "2025-03-15T10:30:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-07-28T14:22:00Z"
}
```

| Field        | Type   | Description                          |
|--------------|--------|--------------------------------------|
| `id`         | string | The unique identifier of the user.   |
| `name`       | string | The full name of the user.           |
| `email`      | string | The email address of the user.       |
| `role`       | string | The access role of the user.         |
| `created_at` | string | The timestamp of profile creation.   |
| `updated_at` | string | The timestamp of the last update.    |

## Error Codes

| Code   | Name                | Description                                      |
|--------|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| `400`  | Bad Request         | The `id` parameter has a wrong format.           |
| `401`  | Unauthorized        | The request does not include valid credentials.  |
| `403`  | Forbidden           | You do not have permission to read this profile. |
| `404`  | Not Found           | No user has the given `id`.                      |
| `429`  | Too Many Requests   | The rate limit is exceeded. Try again later.     |
| `500`  | Internal Server Error | An unexpected error occurred on the server.    |

### Error Response Body

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "No user has the given id."
  }
}
```

| Field            | Type   | Description                              |
|------------------|--------|------------------------------------------|
| `error.code`     | string | A short machine-readable error code.     |
| `error.message`  | string | A clear description of the error.        |

## Procedure

1. Set the `Accept` header to `application/json`.
2. Send a `GET` request to `/api/users/:id`.
3. Replace `:id` with the user identifier.
4. Check the response status code.
5. If the status is `200`, read the user data from the response body.
6. If the status is an error code, read the `error` object for more information.

## Notes

NOTE: The `id` parameter must be a string. Numeric IDs are not accepted.

NOTE: The response includes timestamps in the ISO 8601 format.

NOTE: The `role` field can be one of `developer`, `admin`, or `viewer`.

3 files reformatted
